impact.summary: Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint caches (~/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.{Word,Excel,Powerpoint}/Data/Library/Caches/*). App containers are protected by macOS privacy controls; Outlook (mail) is not covered.
impact.regeneration: Office rebuilds the caches; templates, add-ins and fonts are downloaded again when used.
impact.offline_effect: Online templates and cloud fonts need the network again. Documents, AutoRecovery files and the Office upload center are never matched.
